verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents a JavaScript or Python code step that runs inside a Zap workflow. The Platform CLI (Node.js) is for building and publishing integrations, and the SDK lets external code call Zapier actions; both are adjacent developer tools, not an in-workflow code step. One community report (zapier-comm-11) describes an engineer frustrated by having no way to write a few lines of code, which points the same way.

support.subject: As a developer, I can drop into real code (JavaScript or Python) as a step inside a workflow
